label: Intuitionism: excluded middle is not a law of logic. p ∨ ¬p may be asserted only when a proof of p…
paraphrase: Intuitionism: excluded middle is not a law of logic. p ∨ ¬p may be asserted only when a proof of p or a refutation of p is available, so assent is withheld from undecided instances. Withholding is not denial: the denial ¬(p ∨ ¬p) of every instance is refuted, ¬¬(p ∨ ¬p).
